description: Use this when a stage looks finished: it returns which stage awaits approval (the first unapproved one; later ones stay locked), what the researcher should check and the exact words to tell them. In Claude and ChatGPT it shows the researcher an approve button in the chat; elsewhere, the link to the web screen. No button for stage 1 without a breakdown, nor for screening with records still undecided (it returns human_review instead). It never approves: only the researcher can, with that button or in the web app. Never say a stage is approved until a result says so; never ask for a code. Read-only.
name: revisia_approve_stage
title: Stage approval
